{{Quote|No name can please everybody. We have to decide and enforce our decision. We can’t worry whether every member of both clans is satisfied. I say&mdash;''Rusted Fetters''|Unidentified Broken Columns man|<ref name="Backlash" />}}
This '''individual''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. He was a member of the [[Broken Columns Clan]], a group composed of men and led by the [[Hapan]] [[Tasander Dest]]. In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], during the [[Standard year/Legends|year's]] annual [[Conclave of the Raining Leaves Clan and the Broken Columns Clan|conclave]] with the [[Raining Leaves Clan]], he took part in the meeting that decided on a new name for the clans' merger. He proposed the name ''Rusted Fetters'', but it was not accepted.<ref name="Backlash" />
